reader_summary.overview: Today we have a special episode all about crypto that we present as a resource for people wanting to better understand what it is. This is an audio essay featuring hallway-style conversations with the A16-Z crypto team, as well as outside experts. In these brief segments, we'll take you from the ground up, from the basics to the most current developments.

thesis: The episode presents an audio essay on cryptocurrency that traces the history of digital money from early cryptographic attempts in the 1980s to the 2009 Bitcoin white paper by Satoshi Nakamoto. It explains how Bitcoin solved the double-spending and anonymity challenges through proof of work, enabling open consensus where anyone can participate without trusting a third party, and describes how miners are rewarded with newly created Bitcoin until the supply cap is reached in 2140.
